subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · 3e · Grammaire · Past perfect et discours indirect
description: Règles et automatismes — past perfect et discours indirect.

cards.front: Complète : When I arrived, they ___. (leave)
cards.back: When I arrived, they had left.

cards.front: Traduis : « Je n'avais jamais vu la mer. »
cards.back: I had never seen the sea.

cards.front: Traduis : « Avait-elle déjà terminé ? »
cards.back: Had she already finished?

cards.front: Relie : He ate. Then he left.
cards.back: After he had eaten, he left.

cards.front: Rapporte : She said, “I am ready.”
cards.back: She said that she was ready.

cards.front: Rapporte : He said, “I live here.”
cards.back: He said that he lived there.

cards.front: Rapporte : She said, “I will come.”
cards.back: She said that she would come.

cards.front: Rapporte : He said, “I can swim.”
cards.back: He said that he could swim.

cards.front: Complète : She ___ me that she agreed.
cards.back: She told me that she agreed.

cards.front: Dans un récit au passé, que devient tomorrow ?
cards.back: the next day / the following day
